title: How to Tell Which Fraction Is Bigger
description: A visual way to compare fractions with different denominators, like 2/3 versus 3/5, without a calculator.
narration_lines: Which is bigger, 2 thirds or 3 fifths? Let's compare them.
Split one whole into 3 parts, and fill in 2 of them.
Now split another whole into 5 parts, and fill in 3 of them.
2 thirds fills more of the bar. It's the bigger fraction.

params.footnote: 2/3 ≈ 67%, 3/5 = 60% — more of the bar is filled
